#=# _css_balanced
"" -> True
"{" -> False
"}" -> False
"a { b }" -> True
"a { /* } */ }" -> True
"a { content: \"}\" }" -> True
"a { content: '\\'}' }" -> True
"\"\nx\"" -> False
"/* open" -> False
"a { content: \"open }" -> False
"a {} }" -> False
"@media x { a { b: c } }" -> True

#=# _drop_canvas_clearing
/*[OWUI_VARS_START]*/
html.dark { --a"/*[OWUI_CLEAR_CANVAS_START]*/": red; }
/*[OWUI_VARS_END]*/
/*[OWUI_STRUCTURAL_START]*/
body { a: b }

/*[OWUI_CLEAR_CANVAS_GRADIENT_START]*/
.app { e: f }
/*[OWUI_CLEAR_CANVAS_GRADIENT_END]*/
/*[OWUI_STRUCTURAL_END]*/
/*[OWUI_CUSTOM_START]*/
/*[OWUI_CLEAR_CANVAS_END]*/ .x { g: h }
/*[OWUI_CUSTOM_END]*/

#=# _parse_consult
"{\"hue\": 200, \"chroma\": 30, \"lightness\": 20, \"gradient\": true, \"name\": \"Sea\"}" -> {"hue": 200, "chroma": 30, "lightness": 20, "gradient": true, "name": "Sea"}
"<think>{\"hue\": 1}</think> here: {\"hue\": \"400\", \"chroma\": -3, \"lightness\": 70.6, \"gradient\": \"TRUE\", \"name\": \"  a \\n b  \"}" -> {"hue": 360, "chroma": 0, "lightness": 50, "gradient": true, "name": "a b"}
"{\"hue\": null, \"chroma\": 1, \"lightness\": 1}" -> null
"no json" -> null
"[1, 2]" -> null
"{\"hue\": 1, \"chroma\": 1, \"lightness\": 1, \"name\": \"nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn\"}" -> {"hue": 1, "chroma": 1, "lightness": 1, "gradient": false, "name": "nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn"}
"{\"hue\": 1e400, \"chroma\": 1, \"lightness\": 1}" -> null
null -> null
